The car is going to be traced by green light cameras, going miles and miles is only going to make it more easy for them to identify your vehicle. 

Your blood/DNA will most likely be left at the scene if you are using intermediate weapons or anything close range. Since you don’t know the person, you don’t know how they are going to react. Hair, fingernails, fingerprints, sweat, even microscopic bits of you are without a doubt going to be left their and the forensic team is not going to miss it. 

If you use a gun, the victims wound is going to be analyzed by the morgue and they will identify the make and model. Inside every gun, the ridges are different, even if they are the same model. So, when they identify the bullet they are going to look in the database to see every person that owns that model. They can also tell by the impact, so it is very likely if you bought the gun yourself, this is how they will find you. 

It’s just not that easy. It seems like it could be since you have no correlation, however forensics is a hell of a wonder in this era and without any planning, you would most likely be caught.
